page.overview:
Who is The Owlbear?

is a human barbarian/rogue and a member of the Darrington Brigade. He is played by Taliesin Jaffe.

As of 826 PD, the Owlbear was a human man in his late 30s. When he arrived at the Darrington Estate he clearly hadn't shaved in a few days. He wears an Owlbear cowl with a brown tunic underneath and brown boots. Multiple daggers dangle from his belt and he wields two claw-like weapons in each hand. His mask has apparently two overlapping pieces, one for the owl and the other for the bear.

The Owlbear is a "serious and brooding" figure.

In 826 PD, Taryon Darrington welcomed the Owlbear at his estate in Deastok inviting him to contest for the position in the Darrington Brigade. The Owlbear went first, paired with Farriwen Breeze. Farriwen used her dope monk shit to knock out the Owlbear handily. At the end of her duel, Hazel Copperpot healed her opponent (Buddy) and the Owlbear.
